name: הצעת חוק לתיקון מונחים בחקיקה (יהודה והשומרון)
reason: Terminology for Judea and Samaria; territorial naming issue
r2: Renames West Bank to Judea and Samaria in statutes; territorial terminology, not the state's Jewish identity versus equality.

name: הצעת חוק השבות (תיקון - מיהו יהודי)
reason: Law of Return: only halakhic conversion recognized
r2: Law of Return recognizes only halakhic conversion; defines Jewishness religiously, mainly a religion-and-state issue.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: הכנסת (תיקון - הצהרת אמונים)
reason: Knesset oath to Israel as Jewish and democratic state
r2: Changes MKs' oath to loyalty to Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; entrenches Jewish character.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: מעמד ההכרזה על הקמת מדינת ישראל
reason: Constitutionalizes Declaration incl. equality; counterweight to Nation-State Law
r2: Gives the Declaration constitutional status, adding its full-equality guarantee to balance the Nation-State Law.

name: הצעת חוק יסוד: ישראל - מדינת הלאום של העם היהודי (תיקון - ביטול החוק)
reason: Repeals the Nation-State Basic Law as discriminatory
r2: Repeals Basic Law: Nation-State of the Jewish People, removing the main legal entrenchment of Jewish character.

name: הצעת חוק לתיקון פקודת בריאות העם (חובת קבורה בבית עלמין)
reason: Cremation ban; religious practice, not national character law
r2: Bans cremation, mandates cemetery burial on Jewish religious grounds; religious regulation, not national identity versus equality.

name: הצעת חוק שימוש במונח יהודה והשומרון, התשפ"ה–2025
reason: Terminology for Judea and Samaria; territorial naming issue
r2: Requires the term Judea and Samaria in official use; territorial naming, not the state's Jewish character.

name: הצעת חוק החלת המשפט, השיפוט והמינהל בחבלי הארץ שבריבונות ישראל
reason: Annexation of territories, not Jewish character in law
r2: Applies Israeli law and sovereignty to territories; annexation and borders, not legal entrenchment of Jewish character.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: כבוד האדם וחירותו (תיקון - פגיעה בזכויות)
reason: Limits judicial review over infiltrators; migration and courts
r2: Loosens Basic Law: Human Dignity limitation clause to permit detaining or deporting infiltrators; judicial review, not Jewish character.

name: הצעת חוק-יסוד: מגילת העצמאות
reason: Constitutionalizes Declaration incl. equality; counterweight to Nation-State Law
r2: Constitutionalizes the Declaration of Independence, entrenching its equality principle as a counterweight to the Nation-State Law.
